name: Wittenbeck (Germany)
description: White field with a green stripe along the top and a blue stripe along the bottom edge, charged at the centre with the municipal arms of Wittenbeck (a blue wavy bend between scallop shells and a plant on green).
history: Municipal flag of Wittenbeck; German municipalities use their flags alongside the arms, the hoisted form (Hissflagge) and the hanging banner (Banner) sharing the same design.

features.role: Wittenbeck arms — wavy bend, shells and plant
